title: Harmonious Crisp Italian Tofu Pasta
description: A jammy and crisp Italian dish featuring silken tofu, perfect for a date night, and following ayurvedic-sattvic friendly principles.

ingredients.name: silken tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the canned tomatoes to the skillet, stirring to combine with the garlic and oil, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and reduced slightly.
While the sauce is simmering, prepare the silken tofu by wrapping it in a clean kitchen towel and poaching it in boiling water for 5-7 minutes until crispy on the outside and creamy on the inside.
Remove the tofu from the water and cut it into small cubes, then add it to the skillet with the tomato sauce, stirring to combine.
Stir in the chopped basil, salt, and pepper, and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until the basil is wilted.
Serve the pasta hot, topped with the tomato sauce and silken tofu, and sprinkled with nutritional yeast if desired.
